steps.title: Bem-vindo: Grammar - Volume 41
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Grammar". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

steps.title: Gramática: First Conditional
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "First Conditional"?
options: She will call you if she has time.
I have been studying for three hours.
He told me he would call later.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
